title: Base linear expression
statement: For a Boolean finite-state Turing machine $M$, the base linear expression over 11 registers is the pair whose register list consists of $r_{NC}$, followed by $r_Z$, followed by $W_d(M)$ copies of $r_I$, and whose constant term is $2+W_d(M)$.
caveat: The supplied context does not explain the register labels $r_{NC}$, $r_Z$, and $r_I$.
